lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Li4Fe4Sb8 (reduced formula LiFeSb2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives each Fe, Li, and Sb center eight geometric neighbors within a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, with neighbor distances of 2.68–2.69 Å. Validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Sb-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Fe- and Li-centered polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
